worldcombat.skill.barrier.summary: Create a wall that blocks movement and sight while raising Defense. This Defense increase ends when the wall disappears.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.use.0: Block the approach lane before the opponent charges in
worldcombat.skill.barrier.use.1: Raise the wall tall to cut off a ranged firing line
worldcombat.skill.barrier.use.2: Shelter a partner behind the wall and force the opponent to reroute
worldcombat.skill.barrier.description.0: While the wall stands, Defense is raised by %1$s level(s) for about %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.description.1: The wall is %1$s blocks wide and %2$s blocks tall, standing %3$s blocks ahead; the blocks it adds are real obstacles.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.tall.on: Tall screen: a taller, narrower wall set farther out that blocks sight and ranged attacks and goes up faster; it is narrow enough to walk around and shields for less time.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.tall.off: Bulwark: a wider, lower wall set close that stops a frontal charge and shields longer; it does not block sight or ranged attacks and takes longer to raise.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.growth.0: At level %1$s the wall lasts %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.growth.1: At level %1$s the wall lasts %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.preference.tal: On: a taller, narrower wall set farther out that blocks sight and ranged attacks and goes up faster, but can be walked around and shields for less time. Off: a wide low bulwark that stops a frontal charge and shields longer, but does not block sight or ranged attacks and is slower to raise.
